Attention Is All You Need is a 2017 paper by Ashish Vaswani and seven co-authors at
It introduced the Transformer, a neural network architecture based entirely on
self-attention that dispenses with recurrence and convolutions.
The Transformer uses multi-head attention, so the model can look at different positions
of a sequence in parallel, and adds positional encodings to keep word order.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation, or RAG, was introduced in 2020 by Patrick Lewis and
colleagues at Facebook AI Research, University College London and New York
1 Drop in your papers and notes. Nothing leaves your machine.
2 gknowledge builds a linked wiki, as plain Markdown with sources.
3 Ask questions. Every answer cites the pages it used.
